title: Smooth affine frontier refinement with finite-subfield models
statement:
Fix a prime power $q$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism; def-weil-finite-type-morphism], put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ [def-pc-base-change], and let $(T_\nu)$ be a finite partition of $X_{\mathrm{red}}$ into locally closed reduced $k$-subschemes [def-constructible-stratification; def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction; def-pc-reduced-scheme]. No Frobenius stability of the $T_\nu$ is assumed.

There is $m\geq1$, with $k_m=\mathbf F_{q^m}\subset k$ and $X_m=X_0\times_{k_0}k_m$, and a finite chain of reduced closed $k_m$-subschemes
$$Z_0=(X_m)_{\mathrm{red}}\supset Z_1\supset\cdots\supset Z_t=\varnothing,$$
such that every $U_a=Z_a\setminus Z_{a+1}$ is a finite disjoint union $\coprod_{b\in B_a}U_{a,b}$ of nonempty smooth geometrically connected affine $k_m$-schemes, each smooth of one constant relative dimension $d_{a,b}\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms; def-pc-geometrically-irreducible; def-pc-scheme]. The pieces are open and closed in $U_a$, and the geometric base change of each $U_{a,b}$ is contained as a locally closed subscheme in some $T_\nu$. If $d_{a,b}=0$, then $U_{a,b}\cong\operatorname{Spec}k_m$. Closed and open inclusions have the meanings of [def-weil-closed-immersion; def-weil-open-immersion]. Every chain inclusion, component inclusion and displayed isomorphism is defined over this same $k_m$. For $X_0=\varnothing$ the chain has length zero.

proof.text: Apply the proved geometric-filtration theorem to the reduction of X with the locally closed cover supplied by T. This constructs the closed chain and its nonempty smooth affine geometrically connected pieces by Noetherian induction, each lying in a prescribed stratum. The separate generic good-frontier-refinement theorem and simultaneous irreducible-component construction are unnecessary.

Apply the finite-field model theorem to this already constructed geometric filtration. It returns one extension k_m, the ambient comparison, a closed filtration of (X_m)_red, and geometric comparison isomorphisms for every piece preserving relative dimensions and ambient maps.

For a positive-length filtration choose exactly one component in each layer, with its inclusion the identity. The cover and pairwise disjointness assertions are immediate. For a zero-length filtration the reduced ambient scheme is empty; use a one-step chain from that empty reduction to the canonical empty scheme and take no components. This avoids requiring a literal equality of arbitrary isomorphic empty objects.

For a dimension-zero piece V, etaleness and separatedness make the diagonal clopen in V×V. This product is connected by geometric connectedness and the diagonal is nonempty, so it is surjective and hence an isomorphism. Thus V→Spec k_m is a monomorphism. It is flat, so the Mathlib flat-monomorphism criterion makes it an open immersion. Geometric connectedness makes it surjective; therefore it is an isomorphism. The Lean proof checks this diagonal argument directly.

Use the geometric piece comparison to obtain its image containment in one T_nu. A map from a reduced scheme whose image lies in an immersion factors through that immersion: first lift to the open coborder, then factor through its closed immersion using reducedness. This is proved as reduced_factors_immersion. The resulting factor is an immersion because its composite with T_nu→X_red is one. The ambient equations follow by composition and the comparison equation.
